audit.whatIsWrong: Row 5 (Level 6) is given to Trundle at 3/10 in both layers, but the packet chart marks it Skill and whys[4] opens 'About even at 6'. Every other row already matches the packet.
audit.why: At 6 Cannon Barrage buys zone and dive pressure while Subjugate buys a won brawl — neither side takes the stage outright, which is exactly what the prose says.
audit.corrected: Row 5 set to Skill at 5/10 in both layers.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Trundle's level 1-3 Chomp AD-sap window, Gangplank's level 4-5 out-of-range keg, the Sheen flip, and Subjugate at 6. Four entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer reduces Subjugate to 'Steals your stats. Avoid the brawl.' with no range, no cooldown and no mention that the steal DOUBLES over four seconds. It never names Chomp, Frozen Domain or Pillar of Ice, and it never states the distinction that decides whether you escape: Remove Scurvy cures crowd control, and Pillar of Ice is terrain, so the cleanse does nothing about the wall.
audit.why: Riot text, Subjugate (R): 'Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount stolen is doubled', 650 range, 120/100/80. Chomp (Q) is 300 range on 3.5s and saps attack damage. Pillar of Ice (E) is 21/19.5/18/16.5/15 at 1000 range and 'becoming impassable terrain'. Frozen Domain (W) is 18/17/16/15/14 and grants 'increased healing from all sources'. Remove Scurvy cures crowd control effects only.
audit.corrected: Subjugate given its range, cooldown and doubling; the terrain-versus-cleanse distinction stated; Frozen Domain's healing amplification named as the anti-heal reason.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers in the full layer.
audit.why: Subjugate at 120s rank 1 is the long window worth waiting out; Chomp at 3.5s is effectively always up, so the answer to it is range, not timing.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[9].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three flagged interactions are absent: Chomp is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up rather than the cast is the tell; Frozen Domain amplifies all his healing, which is why Grievous Wounds decides extended trades; and King's Tribute plus Subjugate scale off percent health and stolen resistances, so raw armour is the wrong answer.
audit.why: Kit flags and Riot text: Chomp carries autoReset; Frozen Domain grants 'increased healing from all sources'; King's Tribute heals 'for a percent of its maximum Health' and Subjugate steals resistances outright.
audit.corrected: Auto-reset tell written into report[5].t; the healing amplification into dontsFull[0].d.
